newsitem.title: FRANCE: GdesEaux to achieve downsizing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: GdesEaux to achieve downsizing in 1997.

text.p: Generale des Eaux will complete its asset sale programmme in 1997, chairman Jean-Marie Messier said on Friday.

"We will have sold in 1996 and 1997 more than 25 billion francs of assets and businesses, among which the health activities which will be sold in the coming days," he said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.

"I think that the main effort of downsizing the group will have been achieved in 1997, some more will take place in 1998, but basically the larger part will have been completed before the end of this year," he said.
